verses.translation: When Allah’s ˹ultimate˺ help comes and the victory ˹over Mecca is achieved˺

verses.arabicText: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wara-ayta n-nāsa yadkhulūna fī dīni l-lahi afwājan
verses.translation: and you ˹O Prophet˺ see the people embracing Allah’s Way in crowds

verses.arabicText: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا
verses.transliteration: Fasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika wa-is'taghfir'hu innahu kāna tawwāban
verses.translation: then glorify the praises of your Lord and seek His forgiveness, for certainly He is ever Accepting of Repentance
